high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Fantastic Four," produced by Marvel Studios. The poster features a vibrant blue background with various elements that represent the characters and themes of the film. Characters: In the foreground, there are three main characters dressed in blue and white costumes with the number "4" prominently displayed on their chest. These costumes are iconic to the Fantastic Four. To the right, there is a character with a golden, textured head, which is the Thing, one of the Fantastic Four members. On the left side, there is a character holding a flame
